'''Shakudo boots''' are [[Armor#Boots|boots]] of the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] tier, made by smithing [[copper boots]] with [[shakudo alloy]]. They clear Levitation.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the copper item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give {{Value|Shakudo Boots|armor}} armor with {{Value|Shakudo Boots|durability}} durability, the same armor as the matching diamond piece but with no toughness. The full shakudo set gives 20 armor.

=== Intrinsics ===
* '''[[Cleanse]]''': removes Levitation from the wearer whenever it is applied.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/shakudo_effects/cleanse/feet.mcfunction}}</ref>
* '''Magic protection''': [[Magic protection]] adds 8 protection points against magic damage, such as Poison and Instant Damage.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/magic_protection.json}}</ref>
* '''Regeneration''': Every worn piece of shakudo armor counts towards the tier's regeneration: with one piece the wearer gets {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} I for 3 seconds every 30 seconds, and with two, three and four pieces the interval shortens to 26, 22 and 18 seconds. The [[Elytra#Shakudo Elytra|shakudo elytra]] counts as one piece. Each player has their own timer, which starts when the first piece is put on. The pack defines an elytra bonus that would count five and grant Regeneration II, but the elytra does not carry it, so four pieces is the most that can be reached (see [[Set bonus#Shakudo regeneration]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/shakudo_armour.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/shakudo_effects/regeneration/set_cooldown.mcfunction}}</ref>
* '''Wither resistance''': {{G|E04E}} 1. Each worn piece of shakudo armor adds a level of wither resistance, up to 4, which delays the heart loss of the [[Wither effect]] by 2 seconds for the first level and 1 second for each further level (see [[Wither effect#Shakudo wither resistance]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/shakudo_effects/wither_resistance/apply_resistance.mcfunction}}</ref>

Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

They keep the copper armor item ID, so a [[blast furnace]] melts them into a single copper ingot, and they can be smithed again into hepatizon armor.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[shakudo alloy]], which lets the alloy be reused on a fresh copper item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_boots.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Shakudo armor could not be crafted; this was fixed.}}
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive (2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper instead of 3 gold and 6 copper ingots). Added the regeneration intrinsic and its per-piece bonus. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12|Fixed severe multiplayer lag caused by shakudo armor.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Shakudo armor was nerfed, and its intrinsics became exclusive with the electrum and adamant ones.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|Added wither resistance. The regeneration timer is kept for each player and starts when the armor is put on, and a piece held in the main hand no longer counts toward it.}}
}}
